findings.consequence: Reproduced Fig. 2 and endpoint amplitudes are ~13-14% above the growing-mode evolution of the same initial Delta_d; the rate-unit and epoch one-factor effects are mostly different amounts of the same decaying transient; Candidate A G is biased by +0.4% to +2.6%; growing-mode dominance required by 1D-A section 6 is never checked.
findings.statement: The dust ICs transplant the flat-LCDM growing-mode rate at z=20 (-Z/Delta_d=54.0106 unconverted, 49.7107 converted) onto the tracker, whose regular solution at 0.218 Gyr has -Z/Delta_d=40.0878 and Delta_eff/Delta_d=0.20005 (44.6209 at dressed z=20); a decaying mode is excited.
findings.suggested_resolution: Add an explicit non-default growing-mode IC convention, report the decaying-mode fraction of every convention, restate the convention studies relative to it (requires human approval under AGENTS.md rules 1 and 4).
findings.title: Initial conditions are not the Timescape growing mode

findings.consequence: The bare-versus-dressed spread of any fsigma8-like number is understated by up to about 6 percentage points in the observable window.
findings.statement: g(f)=(2+f)^2/(4+f+4f^2) has g'(f)=(2+f)(6-15f)/(4+f+4f^2)^2; its maximum is g(2/5)=8/7 at dressed z=2.007, so over 0.3<~z<~3 the factor is 1.10-1.14.
findings.suggested_resolution: Successor erratum; historical reports remain frozen.
findings.title: Bare-to-dressed growth-rate factor range 1.025-1.084 is wrong

findings.consequence: CONDITIONALLY_CLOSED (1E-F, 1E-G) and CONDITIONALLY_DERIVED_CONTINUUM_REALIZATION (1E-G) are not supported by any exhibited state satisfying the model's zeroth- and first-order kinematics; 1F-C-R A07 names only the dust-conservation defect.
findings.statement: (a) the clock mismatch J_Xi, the residual of the linearised partition kinematics after F_v is slaved to C_P=0, is returned but never gated, although CLK-H1 (homogeneous clock, no spatial dependence, no perturbative lapse) and the 1E-G fixed-partition branch require J_Xi=0; (b) no zeroth-order identity of the two exact dust-FLRW regions is validated (regional Friedmann, dust conservation, partition kinematics, two-region Q_bar, W_bar with K_D, volume-averaged expansion).
findings.suggested_resolution: Fail-closed gates for J_Xi=0 on CLK-H1 and for the background identities with K_D as explicit input; exhibit a consistent manufactured state or downgrade the status tokens.
findings.title: H1 conditional closure not demonstrated

findings.consequence: The scientific basis of Phase 1E-F onward cannot be audited from the repository alone.
findings.statement: 1E-E ends with S1 primary, H1 comparator and implementation NOT_GRANTED; 1E-F implements H1 with implementation GRANTED and CONDITIONALLY_CLOSED with no committed decision record. The user/human-approved Phase 1E-F and 1E-G specifications cited as scientific authority are not in the repository, nor are three cited audits.
findings.suggested_resolution: Commit the specifications (or faithful excerpts) and the three audits; add an H1 decision record.
findings.title: Authorization, specification and audit provenance missing from the repository

findings.statement: Stated policy is that G is passed explicitly with no hidden unit choices, yet six functions default to G=1.0; harmless because G cancels in 4 pi G rho and callers pass G.
